verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because live multi-session sync is a fair question for collaborative work-management software, but the pack never documents teammates' task or doc changes appearing instantly in open ClickUp sessions without a refresh. The real-time mentions point elsewhere: real-time chat is a different feature, Slack and Teams real-time updates are third-party integrations, embedded Figma real-time collaboration belongs to Figma, and Brain²'s 'real-time' awareness describes the AI's context, not live UI sync.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
